headline: United Airlines Cancels All Remaining Flights to Tulum Starting January
summary: United Airlines has joined other major carriers in dropping its routes to Tulum, though destinations remain accessible via other international and regional airlines.
why: Airline route adjustments reflect commercial demand shifts, capacity management, and profitability assessments across international leisure markets.

impacts.name: United Airlines Holdings Inc
impacts.why: Ending unprofitable routes optimizes airline capacity and cost structure.
